name: Muon Space

overview.value: Muon Space is a satellite systems company, founded in 2021, that designs, builds, and operates high-performance satellite constellations end to end, describing itself as "The Mission Foundry." It has launched MuSat1 and MuSat2 as validation missions on SpaceX Transporter rideshare flights, and built FireSat, a wildfire-detection satellite delivered in sixteen months that returned first-light imagery in 2025. The company operates from facilities in San Jose and Mountain View, California.

focus.value: End-to-end space systems provider designing, building, and operating LEO satellite constellations

notes: Added in the registry self-pop batch B (2026-09-09). Privately held; no ticker.
